 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Kings are coming off a 3-0 loss against the Nashville Predators, and tonight they look to get back in the win column against the New York Islanders . The Islanders are also trying to get back in the win column after 4 straight losses. The Kings take on the Islanders tonight at 10 PM ET.

 Game Notes
 The Kings are without Erik Gustafsson (undisclosed), and they have also scratched Samuel Helenius and Joel Armia in tonight's matchup. The Islanders will be without Jean-Gabriel Pageau (lower body), Mathew Barzal (knee), Alexander Romanov (torn right ACL), and Cal Ritchie (lower body), and they have also scratched Scott Mayfield and Matthew Kessel.
 The starting goaltenders for tonight's matchup are likely to be Anton Forsberg for the Kings and Ilya Sorokin for the Islanders. Forsberg has lost his last 5 starts and is still looking for his 1st win of the season. Ilya Sorokin is 1-2-2 in his last 5, but Sorokin has been playing at an elite level, so if the Kings want to break their losing streak tonight, it will start with getting to Sorokin.
 Puck drop is at 10 P. M. ET.
